integrity: An explicit universal algebraic proof is supplied; finite parameter checks and symbolic computations corroborate selected identities but do not certify all real parameters.
scientific_limitations: Only even cycles and two-periodic symmetric edge probabilities with constant directed circulation; optimizes nonstationary eigenvalue modulus, not arbitrary finite-time mixing nor unrestricted inhomogeneous chains. Historical priority requires independent assessment.
title: Fastest mixing among two-periodic chains on even cycles
